intent.raw_query: Maldives honeymoon for 2, $5000 budget, snorkeling and luxury resorts, March 2026

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise with your partner. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn shades of gold and pink over the Indian Ocean. A quintessential romantic honeymoon experience unique to the Maldives.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the most vibrant coral reefs in the world on a guided snorkeling safari across multiple reef sites. Swim alongside sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of colorful tropical fish. A knowledgeable marine biologist guide accompanies you to explain the ecosystem and point out rare marine life, making it both educational and breathtaking.
experiences.location: South Ari Atoll, Maamigili House Reef

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in the world-famous underwater restaurant surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels revealing a living coral reef teeming with marine life. Enjoy a curated five-course Maldivian and international fusion menu with fresh seafood while nurse sharks and rays glide past your table. An unforgettable luxury dining experience perfect for honeymooners.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Conrad Maldives Rangali Island Resort

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach that glows with natural bioluminescent plankton, creating a magical blue-light effect with every wave and footstep. This rare natural phenomenon is one of the most romantic and awe-inspiring experiences in the Maldives. Combine it with stargazing on a private sandbank for an unforgettable honeymoon memory.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit
experiences.description: Visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture and join a hands-on cooking class led by a local family. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut flatbreads using fresh local ingredients. Explore the island's colorful streets, visit a local school, and gain genuine insight into Maldivian daily life beyond the resort bubble.

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Maldives
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 via Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs. Take the budget-friendly public ferry or shared speedboat transfer to your island. Check in to Aegean Bliss Resort, Maldives - Beachfront room. Freshen up and settle in.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable - in transit
meals.lunch: Not applicable - in transit
meals.dinner: Grab a light snack or meal at the airport before or after arrival. Look for local Maldivian short eats (hedhikaa) like bajiya or gulha at airport kiosks for budget-friendly bites (~$5-8).

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange your transfer to the resort before arrival to save time and money. Public ferries are the most budget-friendly option (~$1-3) but may not run late at night. Shared speedboats cost ~$15-25 per person. Confirm transfer options with Aegean Bliss Resort in advance. Keep essentials in your carry-on for easy access upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and recover from travel. After a leisurely wake-up, explore the resort grounds and beachfront. Take a romantic morning stroll along the beach at sunrise (around 6:00 AM). Dip your toes in the turquoise lagoon and get oriented with the island layout.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the resort's house reef for your first snorkeling session. Rent basic snorkeling gear from the resort or a local shop (~$5-10/day) if not included. Explore the colorful coral gardens and spot tropical fish, sea turtles, and reef sharks. Take a break and relax on the beachfront with a coconut drink.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the spectacular Indian Ocean sunset from the beach. Enjoy a romantic beachside dinner at the resort's restaurant. Look for set menus or local Maldivian dishes which are more budget-friendly than imported options.

meals.breakfast: Resort breakfast if included, or visit a local café near the resort for Maldivian mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread (~$4-6).
meals.lunch: Pack a simple picnic from a local shop or grab a light meal at a budget guesthouse café near the beach (~$6-10).
meals.dinner: Dine at Aegean Bliss Resort restaurant - opt for local Maldivian curry dishes or fish-based meals which are more affordable (~$15-25 per person). Share dishes to save costs.

day_by_day.notes: March is peak season in the Maldives with excellent visibility and calm seas - perfect for snorkeling. Ask the resort about free or discounted house reef snorkeling. Stay hydrated and apply reef-safe sunscreen. This is your orientation day, so keep it relaxed.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise snorkeling session at the house reef when marine life is most active. Look for octopuses, moray eels, and colorful parrotfish in the early morning calm waters. Return for breakfast and plan the day ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a budget-friendly local island hopping trip by joining a shared group tour (~$20-35 per person). Visit a nearby local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture, browse local handicrafts, and see traditional dhoni boat building. Walk through the island streets and visit the local mosque (dress modestly).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by evening. Enjoy a romantic sunset walk along your beachfront. Try stargazing on the beach as March skies in the Maldives are typically clear and spectacular.

meals.breakfast: Maldivian breakfast at a local tea shop (sai shop) - enjoy roshi with curry and black tea (~$3-5).
meals.lunch: Eat at a local island's budget restaurant during the island hopping tour. Try garudhiya (tuna broth soup) with rice and lime (~$5-8).
meals.dinner: Cook a simple meal using local ingredients from a nearby shop, or opt for a budget barbecue night at the resort beach if available (~$10-15).

day_by_day.notes: When visiting local inhabited islands, dress conservatively - cover shoulders and knees out of respect for local customs. Alcohol is only available at resort islands. Carry cash in Maldivian Rufiyaa (MVR) for local island purchases. ATMs may not be available on all islands.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group snorkeling excursion to a nearby famous snorkeling spot or coral garden (~$25-40 per person for a shared dhoni boat trip). Look for manta rays, whale sharks (seasonal), and vibrant coral formations. Bring your own snacks and water to save costs.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and spend the afternoon relaxing on your beachfront. Try stand-up paddleboarding (SUP) if available at the resort or from a local rental (~$10-15/hour). Explore the shallow lagoon and spot starfish and small reef fish without any equipment.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic candlelit dinner on the beach. Many resorts offer special beach dinner setups - check if Aegean Bliss has a budget-friendly option or set a romantic picnic yourself with local foods. Watch for bioluminescent plankton glowing in the waves after dark.

meals.breakfast: Fresh tropical fruit platter and yogurt from the resort or local market (~$4-7).
meals.lunch: Pack sandwiches and snacks from a local shop to bring on the snorkeling excursion (~$5-8).
meals.dinner: Special romantic beach dinner - opt for the resort's set dinner menu if available, or create your own beach picnic with local foods and fresh coconuts (~$20-30 for two).

day_by_day.notes: Book snorkeling excursions through local guesthouses or independent operators rather than resort tour desks to save 30-50% on costs. Always check operator safety standards. Bioluminescent plankton is more visible on darker nights - check moon phase for best viewing.

day_by_day.morning: Take a morning dhoni boat ride to a nearby sandbank (sandbank picnic is a quintessential Maldives experience). Spend time on a pristine white sandbank surrounded by turquoise water - perfect for romantic photos. Snorkel around the sandbank's edges for marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit a local fishing village to learn about traditional Maldivian fishing methods. Watch local fishermen bring in their catch and learn about the pole-and-line tuna fishing tradition. Browse the local market for fresh seafood and tropical fruits at very affordable prices.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort for a relaxing evening. Treat yourselves to a budget-friendly couples massage at the resort spa or a local wellness center (look for promotional rates or shorter session packages ~$40-60 for 30 minutes). Enjoy the evening breeze on your beachfront.

meals.breakfast: Early breakfast at the resort before the sandbank trip - eggs, toast, and fresh juice (~$6-10).
meals.lunch: Sandbank picnic lunch - prepare simple sandwiches, fruits, and snacks the night before, or arrange a basic picnic basket through the tour operator (~$10-15).
meals.dinner: Fresh seafood dinner at a local restaurant - grilled reef fish or lobster (in season) with rice and salad (~$12-20 per person at a local eatery).

day_by_day.notes: Sandbank trips are best in the morning when the tide is lower and the sandbank is more exposed. Apply waterproof sunscreen frequently as there is no shade on sandbanks. Bring a hat, sunglasses, and plenty of water. Some sandbanks disappear at high tide, so confirm timing with your tour operator.

day_by_day.morning: Dedicate the morning to underwater photography or videography at the house reef. If you have an underwater camera or GoPro, capture the stunning marine life. Practice snorkeling techniques to improve your underwater experience. Look for nudibranchs, seahorses, and lionfish in the coral crevices.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the resort island on foot or by bicycle (rent from the resort ~$5-10/day). Discover hidden beach spots, mangrove areas, and local vegetation. Visit any local artisan shops for budget-friendly Maldivian souvenirs like lacquerwork, woven mats, or coral-free jewelry.
day_by_day.evening: Join a budget sunset cruise on a traditional dhoni boat (~$20-30 per person for shared cruise). Watch the sun dip below the horizon while sipping fresh lime juice or coconut water. Look for dolphins that frequently accompany dhoni boats at sunset.

meals.breakfast: Local Maldivian breakfast - bis keemiya (vegetable pastry) and sweet black tea at a local tea shop (~$3-5).
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort or a nearby local café - fresh tuna sandwich or salad (~$7-12).
meals.dinner: Dine at a budget-friendly local restaurant near the resort. Try mas riha (tuna curry) with steamed rice and papadum (~$8-15 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Bicycle rentals are one of the best ways to explore larger islands affordably. Always lock bicycles when unattended. For the sunset cruise, book through local operators or guesthouses for better rates than resort tour desks. Dolphins are commonly spotted in the Maldives - keep an eye on the water surface.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip relaxation day - sleep in and enjoy a slow morning on your beachfront. Practice yoga or meditation on the beach at sunrise for a free wellness experience. Read, journal, or simply soak in the natural beauty of your surroundings.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the nearest local inhabited island's public beach (free entry). Swim, snorkel, and relax away from the resort crowds. Interact with local children and families for an authentic cultural experience. Browse local shops for fresh tropical fruits, nuts, and affordable snacks.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening at the resort - set up a private beach area with a blanket and watch the stars. The Maldives has exceptional stargazing due to minimal light pollution. Download a star map app to identify constellations. Enjoy a nightcap of fresh coconut water under the stars.

meals.breakfast: Indulge in a slightly more special breakfast at the resort to celebrate the midpoint of your trip - fresh tropical fruit, eggs, and coffee (~$10-15).
meals.lunch: Fresh coconut and local snacks from the local island market (~$5-8).
meals.dinner: Cook a simple meal at the resort if kitchen facilities are available, or order a budget-friendly room service meal to enjoy on your beachfront (~$15-20).

day_by_day.notes: This is your rest and recharge day - the Maldives is meant to be savored slowly. Don't over-schedule. Use this time to reconnect as a couple and appreciate the natural luxury of your surroundings. Check your budget midway through the trip and adjust spending for the remaining days if needed.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling expedition to spot the famous Maldivian reef sharks (blacktip and whitetip reef sharks are harmless and commonly seen). Head to the deeper sections of the house reef for shark sightings. These early morning hours offer the best visibility and most active marine life.
day_by_day.afternoon: Take a budget group excursion to a nearby uninhabited island for a Robinson Crusoe experience (~$30-45 per person including boat transfer). Explore the pristine beach, snorkel in crystal-clear waters, and collect unique shells (leave corals and live creatures). Enjoy the feeling of having a private island.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort and freshen up. Visit the resort bar for a mocktail (alcohol-free options are budget-friendly and culturally appropriate) while watching the sunset. Enjoy a romantic dinner at the resort with a special Maldivian-themed menu.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast before snorkeling - banana, energy bar, and water (~$3-5).
meals.lunch: Packed lunch on the uninhabited island - prepare the night before or arrange with the tour operator (~$8-12).
meals.dinner: Resort dinner with a focus on local Maldivian specialties - try kulhi boakibaa (fish cake) as a starter and rihaakuru (fish paste) based dishes (~$18-25 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Reef sharks are completely safe and a highlight of Maldivian snorkeling. Do not touch or chase marine life. Uninhabited island trips are excellent value as you get a private island feel at a fraction of the cost of private island resorts. Bring extra water and sunscreen.

day_by_day.morning: Join a budget group diving or snorkeling trip to a famous dive site in the atoll (~$35-50 per person for snorkeling, ~$70-100 for diving). Look for manta rays, eagle rays, and large schools of fish at channel dive sites. This is often the most spectacular marine experience in the Maldives.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort for a relaxing afternoon. Try a free activity like beach volleyball, beach cricket (popular in the Maldives), or simply float in the lagoon. Explore the resort's gardens and spot local birds and hermit crabs.
day_by_day.evening: Attend a local cultural show if available on the island - traditional Maldivian bodu beru drumming performances are mesmerizing and often free or very low cost (~$5-10). This is a wonderful cultural experience unique to the Maldives.

meals.breakfast: Hearty breakfast before the snorkeling trip - eggs, toast, fresh juice, and fruit (~$8-12).
meals.lunch: Post-excursion lunch at a local guesthouse café - fresh fish sandwich and lemonade (~$8-12).
meals.dinner: Budget barbecue dinner on the beach - many local restaurants offer fresh catch of the day grilled to order (~$12-18 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Channel snorkeling requires some swimming ability as currents can be moderate. Always follow your guide's instructions and stay with the group. Bodu beru performances are a UNESCO-recognized cultural tradition - be respectful and ask permission before photographing performers.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning exploring the underwater world with a focus on macro photography. Look for tiny creatures like blennies, gobies, and flatworms on the house reef. Alternatively, take a free-diving lesson if offered by the resort or local dive school (introductory sessions ~$30-50).
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the local island's Friday Mosque (Masjid) from the outside and explore traditional Maldivian architecture. Walk through the island cemetery to see ancient coral stone grave markers - a unique historical sight. Visit a local school or community center if open to visitors for cultural exchange.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic evening picnic on the beach - gather supplies from the local market (fresh fruits, nuts, local sweets, coconut water) and set up a private beach spot. Watch the moonrise over the Indian Ocean for a magical, completely free romantic experience.

meals.breakfast: Local tea shop breakfast - roshi with tuna curry and sweet black tea (~$3-5).
meals.lunch: Fresh tropical fruit bowl and local snacks from the market (~$5-8).
meals.dinner: Beach picnic dinner with local foods - fresh fruits, local sweets (bondi cake, huni hakuru folhi), and coconut water (~$10-15 for two).

day_by_day.notes: When visiting mosques and religious sites, dress modestly (covered shoulders and legs for both men and women). Remove shoes before entering sacred spaces. Photography inside mosques may not be permitted - always ask first. The beach picnic dinner is one of the most romantic and budget-friendly experiences you can create in the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Final major snorkeling adventure - revisit your favorite spots from the trip and spend quality time underwater. Create a mental or written list of all the marine species you've spotted during your stay. Underwater naturalist checklists are available online and add a fun educational element.
day_by_day.afternoon: Souvenir shopping on the local island - look for authentic Maldivian crafts like thundu kunaa (woven mats), lacquerwork boxes, and miniature dhoni boats. Bargain politely for better prices. Budget approximately $20-40 for meaningful, locally-made souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Special romantic dinner to celebrate your penultimate full day. Splurge slightly on a nicer meal at the resort or arrange a private beach dinner setup yourself with candles and local flowers (~$30-50 for two). Reflect on your favorite memories from the trip.

meals.breakfast: Full Maldivian breakfast spread - mas huni, roshi, boiled eggs, and fresh juice (~$6-10).
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort pool bar or beach shack - fresh salad and grilled fish (~$10-15).
meals.dinner: Special celebration dinner - treat yourselves to the resort's best affordable option or arrange a romantic DIY beach setup with local foods (~$30-50 for two including drinks).

day_by_day.notes: When purchasing souvenirs, ensure items are not made from coral, turtle shell, or other protected marine materials - these are illegal to import into most countries. Authentic locally-made crafts support the local economy. Keep receipts for customs declarations.

day_by_day.morning: Last full day - make the most of it with a final sunrise on the beach. Take a slow morning swim in the lagoon and appreciate the colors of the water one last time. Pack non-essential items to make departure day easier.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final island exploration walk - revisit your favorite spots on the island and take photos to remember the trip. Visit the local tea shop one last time for authentic Maldivian short eats. Leave a review or thank-you note for local businesses that made your trip special.
day_by_day.evening: Final romantic sunset on your beachfront. Take a traditional dhoni boat ride for a last look at your island from the water (~$10-15 for a short private charter or join a shared sunset cruise). Enjoy a farewell dinner at the resort, trying any dishes you haven't yet experienced.

meals.breakfast: Relaxed resort breakfast - enjoy every bite knowing it's your last morning (~$8-12).
meals.lunch: Local tea shop farewell lunch - order a selection of Maldivian short eats to taste everything you might have missed (~$8-12).
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort - order your favorite dishes from the trip and toast to a wonderful honeymoon/romantic getaway (~$20-30 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Begin packing this evening to avoid morning rush on departure day. Separate liquids, snorkeling gear, and souvenirs for easy packing. Check airline baggage allowances - wet snorkeling gear can be heavy. Settle any outstanding resort bills to avoid delays on departure morning.

day_by_day.morning: Final morning - wake up early for one last sunrise swim or beach walk. Complete packing and check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Store luggage with the resort if your transfer is not until later in the day. Enjoy a final cup of Maldivian sweet black tea on the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Depending on your departure flight time, spend remaining hours relaxing on the beach or taking a final snorkel. Arrange your transfer to Velana International Airport - book shared speedboat or public ferry in advance for the most budget-friendly option. Allow plenty of time for transfers and airport procedures.
day_by_day.evening: Depart from Velana International Airport. Reflect on 13 incredible days in paradise - the snorkeling adventures, romantic sunsets, cultural discoveries, and the natural luxury of the Maldives experienced on a budget. Carry home beautiful memories of your honeymoon/romantic getaway.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast or local tea shop - make it special (~$6-10).
meals.lunch: Light meal at the airport or during transfer - Maldivian short eats or airport café (~$8-15).
meals.dinner: Airport restaurant or in-flight meal depending on departure time.

day_by_day.notes: Allow at least 3-4 hours before your flight for island-to-airport transfers, especially if traveling by public ferry. Confirm transfer bookings the night before. Keep travel documents, valuables, and essentials in your carry-on. Declare any purchased items at customs if required. Budget summary tip: A 13-day Maldives budget trip for two can be managed for approximately $1,500-2,500 total (excluding flights) by staying at a guesthouse-style resort, eating local food, and joining shared group excursions.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Late night arrival
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – Late night arrival
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Complete immigration and customs, then meet the Aegean Bliss Resort transfer representative. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer to the property. Check in, receive a traditional welcome drink (fresh coconut water or local fruit juice), and settle into your Beachfront accommodation.

meals.breakfast: N/A
meals.lunch: N/A
meals.dinner: Light welcome snack platter arranged by the resort upon arrival – cold cuts, tropical fruits, and Maldivian short eats left in-room.

day_by_day.notes: Pack a carry-on with essentials (swimwear, sunscreen, camera) for easy access after the long flight. Confirm speedboat/seaplane transfer timing with the resort in advance. Rest well – the adventure begins tomorrow!

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely start. Take your first barefoot stroll along the private beachfront at your own pace. Explore the resort grounds, locate the house reef entry point, and get oriented. Visit the resort's dive/snorkel center to rent or confirm snorkel gear for the days ahead.
day_by_day.afternoon: Settle into the resort's lagoon. Enjoy your first snorkel session directly off the beachfront at the house reef – spot colorful reef fish, parrotfish, and coral formations. Afterward, relax on a sun lounger with a good book and a fresh fruit smoothie from the beach bar.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the sunset from your private beachfront terrace with a glass of sparkling wine. Head to the resort's main restaurant for a romantic candlelit dinner for two.

meals.breakfast: Full buffet breakfast at the resort's main restaurant – fresh tropical fruits, eggs made to order, pastries, and local Maldivian breakfast items like mas huni (tuna and coconut) with roshi flatbread.
meals.lunch: Light lunch at the resort's beachside café – grilled fish sandwich, fresh salad, and coconut water.
meals.dinner: À la carte dinner at the resort's main restaurant – try the fresh catch of the day with local spices, accompanied by jasmine rice and a shared dessert of coconut panna cotta.

day_by_day.notes: Day 2 is intentionally relaxed to recover from travel fatigue and adjust to the time zone. Apply SPF 50+ sunscreen generously – the Maldivian sun is intense even in March.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a sunrise yoga session on the beach (check with the resort for scheduled classes). Afterward, enjoy a hearty breakfast before gearing up for the day's main experience: the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari. Meet the certified guide at the water sports center and board a dhoni boat to explore multiple vibrant coral reef sites across the atoll.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari – visit 2–3 different reef sites including a potential turtle cleaning station and a nurse shark sandbank. Return to the resort by mid-afternoon. Rinse off and enjoy a relaxing couple's massage at the resort spa (book in advance – a 60-minute traditional Maldivian coconut oil massage).
day_by_day.evening: Stroll hand-in-hand along the beachfront at dusk. Enjoy cocktails at the overwater bar as the sky turns pink and orange. Dine at the resort's seafood grill.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast – fuel up with protein-rich options before the snorkeling safari.
meals.lunch: Packed snorkel safari lunch box provided on the dhoni boat – fresh sandwiches, tropical fruit, energy bars, and bottled water (often included in the safari package; confirm in advance).
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's seafood grill – grilled lobster or reef fish with garlic butter, grilled vegetables, and fresh lime sorbet for dessert. Mid-range pricing; order à la carte to manage budget.

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari is one of the signature experiences – book it at least 2 days in advance. Bring an underwater camera or GoPro. March weather is generally excellent with calm seas and good visibility (25–30m). Stay hydrated on the boat.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow morning – sleep in, have breakfast on your private beach terrace if the resort offers in-room dining, and soak in the serenity. Head to the resort's infinity pool for a mid-morning swim with panoramic ocean views.
day_by_day.afternoon: Book a private stand-up paddleboard (SUP) or kayak session through the resort's water sports center. Paddle around the lagoon, explore the sandbank nearby, and enjoy the crystal-clear turquoise water. Alternatively, try a beginner's introductory scuba dive if you've never dived before (resort PADI instructors offer discover scuba sessions).
day_by_day.evening: Tonight is the highlight: the Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise. Board a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni decorated with tropical flowers and candles. Sail into the golden sunset with a private butler serving champagne, canapés, and fresh fruit. Watch for spinner dolphins that frequently accompany dhoni boats at dusk.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast on the terrace (if available) – fresh juice, yogurt parfait, eggs, and tropical fruits for a romantic start.
meals.lunch: Casual lunch at the resort beach bar – fish tacos, a fresh green salad, and a mango lassi.
meals.dinner: Return from the dhoni cruise and dine at the resort's signature restaurant – a set romantic dinner menu for two with Maldivian-inspired flavors; think coconut curry, fresh tuna carpaccio, and a shared chocolate lava cake.

day_by_day.notes: The Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise must be booked directly with the resort at least 48 hours in advance. This is one of the most romantic experiences of the trip – ideal for honeymoon photos. Bring a light wrap or shawl as it can get breezy on the water after sunset.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning snorkeling session at the house reef before the crowds (if any) – the light at 7–8 AM is magical underwater. Spot parrotfish, angelfish, and moray eels. Return for a leisurely breakfast and a slow morning by the beach.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a full couples' spa afternoon at the resort's wellness center. Book a 90-minute treatment package – choose from a hot stone massage, a traditional Maldivian scrub using local herbs and coconut, or a rejuvenating facial. Afterward, relax in the spa's relaxation lounge with herbal teas.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a quiet evening on your private beachfront – set up the resort's complimentary stargazing kit (ask the concierge) or simply lie on the beach and watch the Milky Way appear overhead. The Maldives has minimal light pollution, making stargazing extraordinary.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet with a focus on lighter options – smoothie bowls, fresh fruit platters, and green tea.
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch – grilled chicken wrap, fresh coconut, and a tropical fruit salad from the pool bar.
meals.dinner: Casual dinner at the resort's informal dining venue – wood-fired pizza, pasta, or a Maldivian curry. Budget-friendlier option within the resort to balance the week's spending.

day_by_day.notes: Day 5 is a wellness and relaxation day – intentionally paced for a balanced itinerary. Spa treatments should be booked 24–48 hours ahead. The stargazing experience is best on clear nights; March skies are typically clear in the Maldives.

day_by_day.morning: Today's cultural highlight: the Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit. Board a resort boat to a nearby inhabited local island. Walk through the village, visit the local market, see the traditional boat-building yard (if available), and interact with friendly locals. Begin the hands-on cooking class with a local family or chef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the cooking class – learn to prepare traditional Maldivian dishes such as garudhiya (tuna broth soup), mas riha (tuna curry), and bondi (coconut flatbread). Sit down together and enjoy the meal you've cooked. Explore the local island's beach and pick up handmade souvenirs from local artisans before the return boat ride.
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort refreshed with new culinary knowledge. Freshen up and enjoy a relaxed evening at the resort's overwater bar. Watch the sunset and share stories from the day over cocktails.

meals.breakfast: Early resort buffet breakfast before departure for the local island tour.
meals.lunch: The traditional Maldivian meal prepared during the cooking class on the local island – an authentic and memorable mid-trip lunch experience.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant – order something light after the hearty cooking class lunch. Try the grilled fish of the day with steamed vegetables and a fresh lime sorbet.

day_by_day.notes: The local island visit is a wonderful cultural contrast to the resort bubble. Dress modestly when visiting the local island (cover shoulders and knees out of respect for the local Muslim community). Bring cash (USD) for souvenir shopping as local vendors may not accept cards.

day_by_day.morning: Mid-trip free morning – no planned activities. Sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed if available, and simply be present. Take a long walk along the resort's private beach, collect shells, and breathe in the ocean air.
day_by_day.afternoon: Revisit snorkeling at the house reef or a nearby reef patch. This time, explore a different section of the reef you haven't visited yet. Look for sea turtles, which are commonly spotted in Maldivian reefs in March. Alternatively, try a guided glass-bottom boat tour offered by the resort for a non-swimming reef experience.
day_by_day.evening: Tonight is magical: the Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk. After dark, join a guided walk along a secluded beach section where bioluminescent plankton (Noctiluca scintillans) light up the shoreline with an ethereal blue glow. Wade into the shallows and watch the water sparkle around your feet – one of nature's most romantic spectacles.

meals.breakfast: In-room breakfast or resort buffet – treat yourselves to a slightly indulgent spread (eggs benedict, fresh pastries, fresh-pressed juices).
meals.lunch: Beachside picnic arranged by the resort concierge – a basket with sandwiches, fruit, sparkling water, and cookies enjoyed on a quiet stretch of beach.
meals.dinner: Pre-walk light dinner at the resort's casual dining spot – a shared mezze platter, fresh fish skewers, and a dessert of local tropical fruit sorbet.

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk timing depends on tidal and lunar conditions – the experience is best on darker nights (new moon phase). Confirm availability and timing with the resort upon check-in. No flash photography during the walk to preserve the natural effect. Wear shoes you don't mind getting wet.

day_by_day.morning: Early morning dolphin-watching excursion – book through the resort's water sports desk. Spinner dolphins are abundant in Maldivian waters and are often seen leaping in the bow waves of boats at dawn. Return to the resort for a late breakfast.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enjoy a full afternoon of pure leisure at the resort's infinity pool and beachfront. Order refreshing drinks from the pool butler, listen to the sound of the ocean, and simply unwind. Optional: visit the resort's boutique for a small honeymoon memento.
day_by_day.evening: Romantic in-room dinner or private beach dinner (if offered by the resort as a special arrangement). Request the resort to set up a candlelit table on your private beach terrace with flower petals, fairy lights, and a personalized menu. A perfect mid-honeymoon special evening.

meals.breakfast: Late resort buffet breakfast after returning from the dolphin excursion.
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch – fresh fruit smoothies, a club sandwich, and a shared dessert of chocolate mousse.
meals.dinner: Private beach dinner (request from concierge 48 hours ahead) – a set menu of fresh seafood, Maldivian-inspired courses, and a bottle of wine or sparkling grape juice. This will be a premium cost but is worth the splurge for the honeymoon experience.

day_by_day.notes: The private beach dinner is one of the most iconic honeymoon experiences in the Maldives. Confirm the arrangement, menu preferences, and any dietary restrictions with the resort in advance. Budget approximately $150–$250 per couple for this special dinner as an additional cost.

day_by_day.morning: Second Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (or a different reef route if available). By now you're more experienced snorkelers – ask the guide to take you to a deeper, more advanced reef site. Look for manta rays, which are seasonally present in Maldivian atolls in March.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort and enjoy a relaxing afternoon. Visit the resort's library or reading nook, play a board game together, or take a nap in a hammock strung between palm trees on the beach.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar. Enjoy the golden hour light reflecting off the lagoon. Head to the resort's themed dinner night (many Maldivian resorts host weekly BBQ or cultural nights – confirm with the resort schedule).

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast – energize before the morning snorkel safari.
meals.lunch: On-boat packed lunch during the snorkeling safari or a light meal at the water sports café upon return.
meals.dinner: Resort weekly BBQ night (if available) – an outdoor feast of grilled seafood, meats, salads, and Maldivian desserts under the stars. Great value for the experience offered.

day_by_day.notes: March is one of the best months for manta ray sightings in certain Maldivian atolls – ask the snorkel guide specifically about manta ray spots. Bring an underwater torch/flashlight for exploring deeper reef crevices.

day_by_day.morning: Today's headline experience: the Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience. Dress smartly and head to the resort's (or a nearby resort's partnered) world-famous underwater restaurant. Dine surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels with marine life swimming past – reef sharks, rays, and colorful fish – while enjoying a gourmet meal.
day_by_day.afternoon: After the indulgent lunch, take a slow afternoon walk along the beach or visit the resort's boutique spa for a shorter 30-minute express foot massage or scalp treatment to refresh.
day_by_day.evening: Quiet, romantic evening on your private beachfront terrace. Order room service or a light meal from the resort's casual dining menu. Watch the stars emerge and enjoy the peaceful sound of the Indian Ocean lapping at the shore.

meals.breakfast: Light resort breakfast – save your appetite for the underwater restaurant experience.
meals.lunch: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience – a premium multi-course lunch with fresh seafood, international cuisine, and dessert. This is a splurge meal; budget approximately $100–$180 per person. Reservations are essential and should be made well in advance.
meals.dinner: Light room service dinner – a simple pasta, fresh salad, and sparkling water to balance the day's indulgent lunch.

day_by_day.notes: The Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience is one of the most unique and memorable activities of the trip. Book reservations as early as possible – ideally before departure from home. Smart casual dress code typically applies. Check if the experience is at the Aegean Bliss Resort or requires a transfer to a nearby resort.

day_by_day.morning: Free morning for spontaneous exploration. Rent a bicycle from the resort (if available on the island) and cycle around the resort's paths. Alternatively, enjoy a morning swim in the lagoon, take underwater photos, or simply sit on the sandbank and watch the world drift by.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit the resort's water sports center for a new activity: try windsurfing, wakeboarding, or a banana boat ride for a fun, playful afternoon. Alternatively, book a guided jet ski tour around the island's perimeter for a thrilling perspective of your paradise home.
day_by_day.evening: Second Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise (if you loved the first one) or a sundowner on the resort's sandbank – arrange with the concierge to have a bottle of wine or champagne waiting on a private sandbank at sunset, with just the two of you, the ocean, and the sky.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet – enjoy your favorites from the past 10 days one more time.
meals.lunch: Casual beach shack-style lunch at the resort – fish and chips, coleslaw, and a tropical fruit juice.
meals.dinner: Dinner at the resort's main restaurant – try a dish you haven't had yet, perhaps a Maldivian traditional fish curry with rice and papadum, followed by a local dessert of bondi (sweet coconut bread).

day_by_day.notes: Day 11 is intentionally flexible and fun – a chance to revisit favorites or try something new before the trip winds down. The private sandbank sundowner experience is a beautiful, lower-cost alternative to the full dhoni cruise and should be arranged 24 hours in advance.

day_by_day.morning: Final full snorkeling session at the house reef – a farewell swim with your underwater friends. Spend time floating peacefully over the coral, taking it all in. Take a final underwater video or photos to treasure. Return your rental snorkel gear if applicable.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon packing, organizing souvenirs, and preparing for departure. Visit the resort's gift shop for last-minute Maldivian keepsakes – handmade jewelry, local artwork, or bottled Maldivian sea salt. Enjoy one last long soak in the sun on your private beachfront.
day_by_day.evening: Final romantic dinner at the resort – choose your favorite dining venue from the trip. Dress up for the occasion, toast to the honeymoon, and savor every last bite. After dinner, take a final barefoot walk along the moonlit beach and watch the bioluminescent waves if conditions allow.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet – enjoy a hearty final full breakfast.
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch – keep it light and refreshing with a salad, fresh juice, and a light dessert.
meals.dinner: Farewell dinner at the resort's best restaurant – order your favorite dishes from the trip, share a bottle of wine, and celebrate an unforgettable honeymoon. Consider ordering a special dessert with a message written in chocolate sauce for a sweet farewell touch.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm checkout time and departure transfer details with the resort reception today. Settle any outstanding bills (spa, water sports, special dinners) to avoid a rushed checkout tomorrow morning. Request a late checkout if your transfer allows.

day_by_day.morning: Final sunrise on the beach – wake up early one last time to watch the sun rise over the Indian Ocean from your beachfront. A quiet, deeply personal moment to close the chapter on this magical trip. Enjoy a last breakfast at the resort.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort. Board the resort's speedboat or seaplane transfer back to Velana International Airport. Arrive at the airport with ample time for check-in, security, and duty-free shopping. Pick up Maldivian honey, local crafts, or a bottle of Maldivian coconut-based products as final souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Depart the Maldives with hearts full of memories – sunsets, coral gardens, glowing beaches, and the warm turquoise waters of paradise. Safe travels home.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast – take your time and enjoy every last tropical bite.
meals.lunch: Light meal at Velana International Airport's café or restaurant – a sandwich, fresh juice, and a Maldivian short eat as a final taste of the islands.
meals.dinner: In-flight meal or at your connection airport.

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your return flight details and airport transfer timing the night before. Allow at least 3 hours before your flight departure for the speedboat transfer and airport procedures. Keep all receipts and documentation for travel insurance purposes. Most importantly – carry the memories of this honeymoon forever.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Maldives Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

experiences.name: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise
experiences.description: Embark on a traditional Maldivian wooden boat (dhoni) decorated with flowers and candles for a private sunset cruise with your partner. Enjoy champagne, fresh tropical fruits, and canapés while watching the sky turn shades of gold and pink over the Indian Ocean. A quintessential romantic honeymoon experience unique to the Maldives.
experiences.location: North Malé Atoll, around Veligandu or Baros Island

experiences.name: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari
experiences.description: Explore some of the most vibrant coral reefs in the world on a guided snorkeling safari across multiple reef sites. Swim alongside sea turtles, manta rays, reef sharks, and thousands of colorful tropical fish. A knowledgeable marine biologist guide accompanies you to explain the ecosystem and point out rare marine life, making it both educational and breathtaking.
experiences.location: South Ari Atoll, Maamigili House Reef

experiences.name: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience
experiences.description: Dine in the world-famous underwater restaurant surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels revealing a living coral reef teeming with marine life. Enjoy a curated five-course Maldivian and international fusion menu with fresh seafood while nurse sharks and rays glide past your table. An unforgettable luxury dining experience perfect for honeymooners.
experiences.location: Rangali Island, Conrad Maldives Rangali Island Resort

experiences.name: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk
experiences.description: After dark, walk along a secluded beach that glows with natural bioluminescent plankton, creating a magical blue-light effect with every wave and footstep. This rare natural phenomenon is one of the most romantic and awe-inspiring experiences in the Maldives. Combine it with stargazing on a private sandbank for an unforgettable honeymoon memory.

experiences.name: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit
experiences.description: Visit a local inhabited island to experience authentic Maldivian culture and join a hands-on cooking class led by a local family. Learn to prepare traditional dishes such as mas huni (tuna and coconut), garudhiya fish soup, and coconut flatbreads using fresh local ingredients. Explore the island's colorful streets, visit a local school, and gain genuine insight into Maldivian daily life beyond the resort bubble.

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — flight in transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Velana International Airport at 22:30 on flight UA. A dedicated Aegean Bliss Resort butler will greet you at the arrivals hall with a welcome garland. Enjoy a private speedboat transfer to the resort (approximately 35–45 minutes), complete with chilled towels, champagne, and stargazing over the Indian Ocean. Upon arrival, receive a traditional Maldivian welcome with fresh coconut water and a private villa check-in. Settle into your Beachfront villa and unwind.

meals.breakfast: In-flight or airport lounge
meals.lunch: In-flight or airport lounge
meals.dinner: Light welcome platter of tropical fruits, artisan cheeses, Maldivian sweet bread (roshi), and a bottle of chilled Moët & Chandon Rosé arranged in your villa upon arrival — compliments of Aegean Bliss Resort

day_by_day.notes: Given the late arrival at 22:30, no formal activities are planned. Request a late-night turndown service with rose petals, candles, and a warm bath draw if celebrating a honeymoon. Keep Day 2 relaxed to recover from travel.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely private breakfast on your beachfront villa deck, watching the sunrise over the turquoise lagoon. Take a gentle stroll along the resort's pristine white sand beach and acclimatize to the island paradise. Visit the resort's spa for a complimentary welcome treatment — a 30-minute Maldivian coconut oil foot ritual to ease travel fatigue.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon at the resort's overwater infinity pool with dedicated butler service. Enjoy signature tropical cocktails, fresh ceviche, and lobster sliders from the pool menu. Explore the resort's house reef with complimentary snorkeling equipment provided — spot reef sharks, sea turtles, and vibrant coral formations just steps from your villa.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic private beachfront dinner set up by your butler — a candlelit table on the sand with personalized menu, a dedicated chef, and live acoustic guitar. Choose from a curated menu of fresh Maldivian lobster, seared yellowfin tuna, and a decadent chocolate fondant dessert.

meals.breakfast: Private villa breakfast — eggs Benedict, tropical fruit platters, freshly squeezed juices, and Maldivian black tea served on your deck
meals.lunch: Pool bar dining — seared tuna poke bowls, truffle lobster sliders, and fresh coconut sorbet
meals.dinner: Private beachfront candlelit dinner — Maldivian lobster thermidor, grilled sea bass with lemon butter, and dark chocolate lava cake with vanilla bean ice cream

day_by_day.notes: This is a gentle reorientation day — no transfers or excursions required. Inform the butler of any dietary restrictions or honeymoon preferences to personalize the experience. Champagne and rose petal turndown service can be arranged for the evening.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari — Embark on a guided snorkeling safari departing from the resort's jetty at 08:00. Your expert marine biologist guide will lead you across multiple pristine coral garden sites teeming with manta rays, Napoleon wrasse, clownfish, and hawksbill turtles. Snorkeling equipment, underwater cameras, and refreshments are provided on the private dhoni boat.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by midday. Enjoy a leisurely lunch at the resort's signature overwater restaurant. Spend the afternoon indulging in a couples' spa journey at the Aegean Bliss Spa — choose from a 90-minute 'Ocean Harmony' couples massage using warm volcanic stones and Maldivian coconut oil, followed by a private Jacuzzi session overlooking the lagoon.
day_by_day.evening: Dine at the resort's premium à la carte restaurant, featuring a curated menu of contemporary Maldivian-Mediterranean fusion cuisine. Order the chef's tasting menu (7 courses) paired with a sommelier-selected wine flight.

meals.breakfast: Early continental breakfast box prepared by the resort before the snorkeling safari — fresh pastries, tropical fruits, yogurt parfait, and thermos coffee
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant — grilled reef fish with mango salsa, prawn linguine, and passion fruit panna cotta
meals.dinner: Resort signature restaurant — 7-course chef's tasting menu featuring Maldivian spiced crab bisque, pan-seared foie gras, wild-caught sea bass, and a dessert trio

day_by_day.notes: The Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari is one of the featured resort experiences. Book in advance through your butler. Apply reef-safe sunscreen only — the resort provides complimentary eco-friendly sunscreen. Best snorkeling visibility is typically in the morning hours.

day_by_day.morning: Begin the day with a private sunrise yoga session on your beachfront villa deck or the resort's dedicated yoga pavilion, led by the resort's resident yogi. Follow with a nourishing wellness breakfast. Spend the late morning kayaking or paddleboarding through the calm lagoon waters surrounding the resort island.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit — Board a private speedboat to a nearby inhabited local island. Your guide will introduce you to authentic Maldivian village life, local markets, and traditional crafts. Join a hands-on cooking class learning to prepare classic Maldivian dishes: mas huni (tuna and coconut salad), garudhiya (fish broth), and Maldivian sweet bondibaiy (coconut rice pudding).
day_by_day.evening: Return to the resort by early evening. Freshen up and enjoy cocktails at the resort's overwater sunset bar. Dine at the resort's beachside grill restaurant — a relaxed yet luxurious setting featuring live fire cooking with the freshest catch of the day.

meals.breakfast: Wellness breakfast at the resort — açaí bowls, avocado toast on artisan bread, smoked salmon, and cold-pressed green juices
meals.lunch: Traditional Maldivian meal prepared during the cooking class on the local island — mas huni, roshi flatbread, and fresh coconut water
meals.dinner: Beachside grill — whole grilled lobster, wagyu beef skewers, charred corn with truffle butter, and a shared chocolate fondue for two

day_by_day.notes: The local island visit offers a wonderful cultural contrast to the resort luxury experience. Dress modestly when visiting the local island (shoulders and knees covered out of respect). The cooking class typically lasts 2–3 hours. Confirm departure time with your butler the evening prior.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow morning with breakfast in bed delivered to your villa. Take a leisurely swim in the crystal-clear lagoon directly from your beachfront villa. Visit the resort's water sports center to try a new activity — jet skiing, wakeboarding, or a guided glass-bottom kayak tour over the house reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience — Descend into the resort's iconic semi-submerged underwater restaurant for a truly unforgettable multi-course lunch. Surrounded by floor-to-ceiling glass panels revealing a breathtaking aquatic world of reef fish, rays, and coral formations, savor a curated 5-course seafood tasting menu crafted by the resort's executive chef.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise — Board a traditional Maldivian wooden dhoni boat decorated with fresh tropical flowers, candles, and fairy lights. Drift across the Indian Ocean as the sun melts into the horizon, painting the sky in shades of amber and rose. Enjoy a private butler service with canapés, a charcuterie board, and a bottle of vintage Dom Pérignon Rosé. Watch for dolphins often spotted at sunset in these waters.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast in bed — freshly baked croissants, smoked salmon bagels, seasonal tropical fruits, fresh orange juice, and a French press coffee
meals.lunch: Underwater Restaurant — 5-course seafood tasting menu: tuna tartare, lobster bisque, seared scallops, grilled reef fish with saffron risotto, and a sea-salted caramel tart
meals.dinner: Light post-cruise dinner in the villa — a private charcuterie and mezze spread with artisan breads, imported cheeses, Maldivian smoked fish, olives, and fresh tropical fruits

day_by_day.notes: Day 5 features two of the most iconic resort experiences — the Underwater Restaurant and the Sunset Dhoni Cruise. Book both well in advance as they are highly sought after. The Sunset Dhoni Cruise departs approximately 90 minutes before sunset — confirm exact timing with your butler based on the day's sunset schedule.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a full morning of pure relaxation and luxury. Lounge on your private beachfront terrace with a fresh breakfast, read, and soak in the paradise surroundings. Optional: Book a private snorkeling session with the resort's resident marine biologist for a personalized reef tour of the house reef — spot sea turtles, reef sharks, and rare nudibranch species.
day_by_day.afternoon: Indulge in a full afternoon at the Aegean Bliss Spa. Begin with a traditional Maldivian 'Dhivehi Beys' herbal steam ritual, followed by a 60-minute deep tissue massage and a 45-minute anti-aging facial using premium ESPA or Sisley products. End with a refreshing dip in the spa's private plunge pool.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk — After dark, your resort guide leads you along a secluded stretch of beach glowing with ethereal blue bioluminescent plankton. Each step in the wet sand sparks a magical blue glow. Bring a light wrap and enjoy the surreal, romantic spectacle under a canopy of stars. Return to your villa for a romantic turndown surprise arranged by your butler.

meals.breakfast: Beachfront villa breakfast — eggs any style, smoked salmon, tropical fruit platter, freshly baked pastries, and iced mango lassi
meals.lunch: Spa cuisine lunch at the spa lounge — quinoa and roasted vegetable salad, cold-pressed juices, and a raw chocolate energy ball dessert
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining — a 4-course menu delivered by your personal butler: burrata with heirloom tomatoes, lobster bisque, pan-seared duck breast with truffle jus, and a raspberry soufflé

day_by_day.notes: The Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk is weather and tide dependent — the phenomenon is most visible on darker nights (avoid full moon periods if possible). Your butler will confirm the best timing. The walk typically lasts 45–60 minutes. Wear comfortable sandals and bring a light shawl for the evening breeze.

day_by_day.morning: Celebrate the midpoint of your trip with a sunrise champagne toast on your beachfront deck. Enjoy a leisurely morning swim and a leisurely breakfast. Optional: Take a private fishing excursion on a traditional dhoni — try your hand at traditional Maldivian pole-and-line fishing in the deep blue waters just beyond the lagoon.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon exploring the resort's amenities at your own pace. Visit the resort's boutique for Maldivian handicrafts and souvenirs. Enjoy a private mixology class at the overwater bar — learn to craft signature Maldivian-inspired cocktails using local ingredients like pandan, coconut, and fresh tropical fruits.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a romantic overwater restaurant dinner with a table positioned over the glass floor panels, watching reef fish glide beneath your feet. Order the resort's signature 'Ocean to Table' menu featuring the day's freshest catch prepared to your preference.

meals.breakfast: Champagne breakfast on the villa deck — fresh fruit skewers, smoked salmon blinis, miniature pastries, and a bottle of Moët & Chandon Brut
meals.lunch: Casual pool bar lunch — fresh tuna tataki, grilled prawn skewers with chimichurri, watermelon and feta salad, and mango sorbet
meals.dinner: Overwater restaurant — 'Ocean to Table' menu: reef fish ceviche, grilled whole lobster with garlic herb butter, saffron-infused seafood paella for two, and a shared crème brûlée trio

day_by_day.notes: The private fishing excursion is an optional add-on — confirm availability and departure time with your butler. Any fish caught can be prepared by the resort's chef for your dinner. The mixology class is a fun, interactive afternoon activity perfect for couples.

day_by_day.morning: Coral Garden Snorkeling Safari (Second Excursion — Different Sites) — Return to the water for a second snorkeling safari visiting different coral garden locations not covered in the first excursion. Your marine biologist guide will take you to deeper sites with larger marine life — eagle rays, whale sharks (seasonal), and expansive table coral formations. Depart at 07:30 for the best conditions.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the resort by noon. Enjoy a leisurely lunch at the overwater restaurant. Spend the afternoon on a private sandbank excursion — your butler arranges a private transfer to a secluded, uninhabited sandbank in the middle of the ocean. A luxury picnic setup with Champagne, fresh fruit, and gourmet snacks awaits. Swim, sunbathe, and enjoy absolute seclusion in paradise.
day_by_day.evening: Sunset cocktails at the resort's overwater bar followed by a relaxed dinner at the resort's beachside grill. Enjoy live Maldivian traditional music and a cultural performance arranged by the resort.

meals.breakfast: Pre-excursion continental breakfast box — granola bars, tropical fruit, yogurt, and thermos of coffee
meals.lunch: Overwater restaurant post-snorkeling — grilled barramundi with lemon caper sauce, prawn linguine, and a mango panna cotta
meals.dinner: Beachside grill — grilled tiger prawns, whole roasted snapper, truffle mac and cheese, and a decadent tiramisu

day_by_day.notes: The private sandbank excursion is a truly unmissable Maldivian luxury experience. Arrange this through your butler at least 1–2 days in advance. Apply generous reef-safe sunscreen on the sandbank as there is no shade. Bring a hat and sunglasses. The sandbank visit typically lasts 2–3 hours.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a slow, indulgent morning. Sleep in, enjoy breakfast in bed, and take a long soak in your villa's outdoor bathtub filled with tropical flowers and essential oils. Spend the late morning at the resort's infinity pool with a good book and refreshing cocktails.
day_by_day.afternoon: Underwater Restaurant Dining Experience (Evening Slot) — Reserve the resort's underwater restaurant for a special afternoon tea experience (if available) or an early dinner slot to experience the underwater world in different lighting. Alternatively, enjoy a private overwater villa upgrade experience — speak to your butler about arranging a surprise overwater bungalow day-use for an afternoon of luxury.
day_by_day.evening: Private Sunset Dhoni Cruise (Second Experience) — Celebrate a special honeymoon milestone with a second private dhoni cruise, this time with a personalized touch — a customized message in a bottle, a slideshow of your trip photos displayed on the boat, and a surprise cake. Watch the stars emerge as the boat drifts back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: In-villa breakfast in bed — French toast with caramelized banana and maple syrup, fresh berry smoothie bowl, and artisan coffee
meals.lunch: Light poolside lunch — lobster rolls, truffle fries, fresh coconut water, and a tropical fruit tart
meals.dinner: Underwater Restaurant (evening slot) — 6-course degustation menu: oysters with champagne mignonette, tuna tataki, lobster bisque, seared scallops, grilled sea bass, and a chocolate and raspberry dessert symphony

day_by_day.notes: Day 9 is designed as a purely indulgent, romantic day with no strenuous activities. If celebrating an anniversary or honeymoon milestone, inform your butler in advance to arrange personalized surprises such as flower arrangements, a private photo session, or a custom dessert message.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for a private sunrise snorkeling session on the house reef — experience the magical early morning light filtering through the water as the reef comes alive. Return for a hearty breakfast. Spend the late morning on a guided dolphin watching cruise — Maldivian waters are home to spinner and bottlenose dolphins frequently spotted in the morning hours.
day_by_day.afternoon: Maldivian Cooking Class & Local Island Visit (Second Island — Different Experience) — Visit a second local inhabited island for a different cultural perspective. This visit focuses on traditional Maldivian boat building (dhoni craftsmanship), local fishing techniques, and a visit to a traditional Maldivian home for a family-cooked meal experience.
day_by_day.evening: Bioluminescent Beach Night Walk (Second Experience) — Experience the magic of the bioluminescent beach for a second time, this time with a private setup — your butler arranges a small floating lantern release ceremony on the beach following the walk, a deeply romantic and memorable experience.

meals.breakfast: Resort restaurant breakfast — full cooked breakfast with eggs Benedict, smoked salmon, tropical fruits, and freshly squeezed juices
meals.lunch: Traditional home-cooked Maldivian meal on the local island — mas riha (fish curry), roshi, garudhiya broth, and fresh coconut dessert
meals.dinner: In-villa private dining — surf and turf: butter-poached lobster tail and wagyu beef tenderloin with seasonal vegetables, truffle mashed potato, and a shared vanilla bean crème brûlée

day_by_day.notes: The dolphin watching cruise is best in the early morning — confirm departure time with your butler. The lantern release ceremony on the beach should be arranged in advance and uses biodegradable, eco-friendly floating lanterns approved by the resort. A beautiful symbolic gesture for honeymooners.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a final full day of pure resort luxury. Begin with a private couples' yoga and meditation session on the beach at sunrise, followed by a wellness breakfast. Spend the morning exploring the resort's water sports offerings — try scuba diving (resort offers PADI-certified dive excursions for beginners and certified divers), parasailing, or a submarine tour of the outer reef.
day_by_day.afternoon: Full afternoon spa indulgence — book the resort's signature 'Maldivian Royal Couples' Retreat': a 3-hour immersive spa journey including a coconut shell exfoliation, a four-hands massage, a floral bath ritual, and a private relaxation lounge session with herbal teas and spa cuisine.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort's most prestigious dining venue — the overwater fine dining restaurant. Request the chef's table experience for an intimate, interactive dinner where the executive chef personally presents and explains each course. Pair with a curated wine journey selected by the resort's head sommelier.
